title: Example Game Hidden Rooms — How to Find Cracked Walls
description: Find Example Game hidden rooms by checking cracked walls, opening them with an attack, and confirming the room on your map.
meta: One procedure, plus the caveats in the cited guide. Placement and rewards can move between patches.

home_also.title: Hidden rooms
home_also.em: Cracked walls and what the map shows

sources: Player thread: where are the cracks?
body:
Find Example Game hidden rooms by checking walls for a crack and striking it. That wall check is how the room opens. The find counts toward the exploration achievement the guide names.

How to spot the crack

  • Scan walls for a small crack near the top. Sweep each corridor once.
  • Stand close and strike the crack. A notification confirms the find.
  • The room then appears on the map. The passage itself may stay undrawn.

What’s inside

Reported rewards include crafting materials, relics, and consumables. Name only the categories your sources agree on.

Does the map show them?

Only after you open one. The guide describes the map marker as the result of the find, so the search is by eye.

If you cannot find the entrance

  • The minimap is empty: look at the walls. The marker is not a clue you can follow beforehand.
  • The crack is hard to see: check the upper edge, step closer, and strike. Use the notification as confirmation.
  • The room is marked and no corridor is drawn: return to the wall you opened.
  • You are following a second, crackless tip: give that one its own sentence and its own source. Keep it distinct from the cracked-wall procedure.

Quick FAQ

How many hidden rooms are there?
The achievement records finding one. The cited guide does not set a fixed total.

Do they respawn?
The cited guide does not document respawn. Treat each crack as a find on that visit.

Record the guide’s stated version in this note. Cracked-wall steps can stay stable while room placement and reward pools change. A second secret with a different tell stays labeled as a separate report.
